propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that default to max_results=50, silently truncating projects with more than 50 issues
issues beyond the first 50 in a project appear to have no links or comments in the resulting maps, causing spurious diff mutations and silent incompleteness without raising errors
three separate methods (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, get_parent_map) each independently implement pagination loops, creating duplication and maintenance risk for a recurrent defect class
Jira DC silently truncates maxResults above a configured server limit, so pagination must advance by actual returned rows and terminate only on empty pages, not by requested batch size
a unified _paged_search helper method must be extracted and consumed by all three whole-project readers to eliminate hand-rolled pagination loops and prevent future instances
